problem: It addresses the need to bridge the gap between local Markdown notes in Obsidian and structured content hosted on an XWiki platform.

relations.evidence: OpenProject links (optional): published pages are linked to the work packages their notes link to, without duplicates, and the link is removed when it leaves the note.

summary: XWiki Publisher allows users to publish Markdown notes to an XWiki instance and pull XWiki pages back into the vault as Markdown.
